# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 89 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 89

**1** Jesus said: "Why do you wash the outside of the cup? Do you not realize that the one who made the inside is the same who made the outside?"

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Realize" — more cognitive than "understand"
- "The same who made the outside" — identity of the maker
- The cosmological claim is preserved without moral addition
